description: Defines the TransactionHandler class and related structures for managing surfaceflinger transactions in Android.

classes.name: TransactionHandler
classes.description: Manages transaction queues and states for surfaceflinger frontend.

classes.name: TransactionFlushState
classes.description: Holds state information for flushing transactions, including transaction pointer, timing, and buffers.

classes.name: TransactionReadiness
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the readiness state of a transaction.

methods.name: hasPendingTransactions
methods.description: Checks if there are pending transactions.

methods.name: addTransactionReadyFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to determine transaction readiness.

methods.name: removeFromStalledTransactions
methods.description: Removes a transaction from the stalled list.

methods.name: popTransactionFromPending
methods.description: Removes a transaction from the pending queue.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies filters to determine transaction readiness.
